topic: Tesla next-gen Roadster 'flying' reveal (Oct 15, 2026) and the marketing playbook behind it

claims.claim: Tesla unveiled the next-generation Roadster on Oct 15, 2026 at a livestreamed event at a SpaceX test facility in Texas (McGregor, near Waco).

sources.title: Tesla unveils long-delayed Roadster developed with SpaceX, fueling merger speculation
Elon Musk shows off 'flying' Tesla Roadster after years of delays

claims.claim: In the demo the car drove up a curved ramp, launched, flipped mid-air and landed using cold-gas thrusters, clearing other vehicles.

sources.title: Tesla's new Roadster takes flight during dramatic unveiling at SpaceX facility
Elon Musk shows off 'flying' Tesla Roadster after years of delays

claims.notes: An aviation expert told CNN it is closer to hopping.

claims.claim: Musk said production starts in 2028; no price was given; a $5,000 deposit reserves a non-flying model.

sources.title: Elon Musk shows off 'flying' Tesla Roadster after years of delays

claims.claim: Musk claims 0 to 60 mph in under one second and a top speed above 230 mph for certain versions.

sources.title: Tesla's new Roadster takes flight during dramatic unveiling at SpaceX facility

claims.notes: Not independently verified; labelled as Tesla's claims on screen.

claims.claim: The reveal came after about nine years of delays (the Roadster was first unveiled in November 2017).

sources.title: Tesla sets Roadster event for Thursday after nearly 9 years of delays

claims.claim: Major outlets (CNN, CBS News, NBC News, CNBC, Fox Business, Axios) covered the reveal; it came a week before Tesla's Q3 results on Oct 21, 2026.
